messages:
From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acme-logistics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20 09:12 -0700
Subject: Issue with vendor portal legal entity mapping — urgent

Hi Marcus,

We tried to accept the PO that Redwood sent yesterday but the portal is rejecting our account — it looks like our registration got associated with "Acme Holdings LLC" (our parent) instead of "Acme Logistics Inc." (the invoicing/legal entity). When we try to accept the PO it shows a mismatch and an error saying the invoice entity is not authorized.

We completed the Coupa invite this morning; attached are our registration confirmation and a copy of our W-9 that shows the legal name "Acme Logistics Inc." and EIN. Can you advise the quickest path to correct the mapping so we can receive POs and submit invoices? We have a time-sensitive shipment next week so any help is appreciated.

Attachments: Acme_registration_confirmation.pdf (pdf), W-9_AcmeLogistics.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Sarah Jensen
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Acme Logistics Inc.
Onboarding: onboarding@acme-logistics.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acme-logistics.com>
Date: 2026-09-20 09:45 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Issue with vendor portal legal entity mapping — Acme Logistics (please triage)

Priya / Dev — forwarding an inbound from Acme Logistics. They completed the invite but the vendor record in Coupa appears to be linked to the parent company rather than the invoice entity. That is causing PO acceptance and invoice routing failures.

Can procurement please: 1) confirm which vendor record is currently active in Coupa/Ariba (vendor id if available), 2) re-link or merge the correct legal entity (Acme Logistics Inc.) so invoices map to the PO, and 3) let the vendor know any required docs/format? I attached their W-9 and registration confirmation that show the legal name and EIN.

If we need a formal mutual action plan or a short SOW to change the vendor mapping, flag it here and I will escalate. This is time-sensitive.

Marcus
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Acme_registration_confirmation.pdf, W-9_AcmeLogistics.pdf

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20 10:30 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Issue with vendor portal legal entity mapping — Acme Logistics (triage steps)

Thanks for the flag, Marcus. Hi Sarah — sorry for the interruption. I pulled the vendor record and see two entries: ACME-HOLDINGS (parent) vendor id ACME-8802 and ACME-LOGISTICS (child) vendor id ACME-9931 but the active payment route is currently attached to the Holdings record. That explains the PO acceptance mismatch.

Next steps (proposed):
- Sarah: please confirm the exact legal name for invoices (as it should appear on the PO) and provide official tax ID (EIN) and, if available, DUNS. I have W-9 attached already which helps.
- Dev: I will open an internal ticket to request vendor re-link/merge in Coupa and set the ACME-LOGISTICS record as the payment-authorized entity.
- Laura: can you confirm whether we need an updated vendor packet or additional compliance evidence (e.g., ACH remit instructions) before we flip the payment routing?

I opened an internal support issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4827 — I will add you both. Target ETA: 24-48 hours once the data is confirmed. If we need legal signoff we will escalate.

Action items for Sarah: confirm legal invoice name (exact), EIN, remit address, and preferred invoice contact.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Hi Priya, Marcus — thanks for the quick response. Confirming the invoicing/legal name should be exactly: "Acme Logistics Inc." (no punctuation differences). EIN: 12-3456789. DUNS: 53-987-1234. Remit address: 210 Harbor Rd, Suite 400, Oakland, CA 94612. Invoice contact: invoices@acme-logistics.com.

We noticed during registration that the portal pre-filled the parent company due to our umbrella registration — we submitted the invite under Acme Holdings by mistake and then accepted. We can re-create or amend the record but would prefer Redwood to re-link the existing child record (ACME-9931) to active payment routing to avoid losing any historical PO references.

I have attached a screenshot of the Coupa invite flow and the signed W-9 again. Also sharing a secure upload where our finance team placed the EIN verification: https://files.acme-logistics.com/redwood-proof/EIN-verify (link to S3).

Attachments: Coupa_invite_screenshot.png, W-9_AcmeLogistics.pdf

Best,
Sarah Jensen
Acme Logistics Inc.
